issues.detail: The Hebrew 'כִּמְלוּנָ֥ה בְמִקְשָׁ֖ה' means 'like a hut in a cucumber field' (מִקְשָׁה = cucumber field/garden). The Chinese renders 'בְמִקְשָׁה' as '錘子中的' (in a hammer), which is a mistranslation of the noun. 'מִקְשָׁה' is not 'hammer' (which would be מַקֶּבֶת or similar), but a cucumber field. This changes the meaning of the simile.
